title: Shirley-Eustis House

services.name: Admission
services.desc: The orchards, gardens, and grounds are free and open to the public year-round, from dawn until dusk. Guided, public tours of Shirley Place are offered on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, Thursdays, and Fridays at 12pm and 2pm. No advance registration is required. Tour schedule is subject to change - please see the calendar on our homepage for up-to-date tour offerings. Parking is available on Shirley Street and in the gravel lot next to the Carriage House on Rockford Street. Tours en Español: para programar un recorrido en español, envíe un correo electrónico a programs@shirleyeustishouse.org.
